package.name: cobot_operation
package.description: Pick choreography node (Python). Serves /cobot/pick_can by chaining cobot_control primitives (MoveToPose action, set_output_bit service, the /cobot/state sensor poll). Owns tool profiles (cobot_setup.yaml), teach-point trajectories, the left/right place state and the operation report. Dependency rule: rclpy + cobot_interfaces ONLY — never imports motoman / YMConnect code.
